title: Department of Energy: Phase 56N Verified Remediation Decision
summary: GAO lists recommendation 13 Open because DOE's 2025 AI inventory omitted required operational or pilot start dates and demographic-variable information for several use cases. Phase 56N decision: Publish the exact inventory-recommendation non-closure; it adds a named data-quality rail without substituting for DOE's FY 2025 FISMA result.
key_findings: Status period: GAO review of DOE's 2025 AI use-case inventory as of February 2026.
Evidence state: Partially Closed to Partially Closed.
Continuation rule: Reopen when GAO changes recommendation 13 status or DOE publishes a corrected inventory that GAO accepts as implementation evidence.
why_it_matters: The record adds exact implementation, non-closure, component, or portfolio evidence while keeping recommendation states and operational outcomes distinct.
ftfn_relevance: Separates recommendation implementation from performance, service, mission, safety, and readiness outcomes.
Keeps source owner, record identity, status period, limitation, and continuation rule attached.
evidence_limits: Inventory completeness is an AI governance control, not a measure of model performance, adoption, mission benefit, cybersecurity effectiveness, or DOE-wide readiness.
A corrected inventory accepted by GAO, recommendation closure, the department-wide FY 2025 FISMA result, and measured system outcomes.
No entity ranking, composite, productivity, readiness, value, or causal claim is supported.
